name: icloud-mail
description: Read, search, organize, draft, and send iCloud Mail through a local, dependency-free MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Read, organize, draft, and send iCloud email
interface.longDescription: iCloud Mail connects Codex directly to Apple's TLS IMAP and SMTP services. A temporary local setup page validates an app-specific password and saves it in macOS Keychain. Search, read, organize, draft, and send mail on demand without creating a local mailbox copy or email index. Requested mail returned to Codex enters the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Find recent iCloud email and draft a reply.
Review iCloud Mail attachments that need attention.
